description: A cozy, rustic bedroom corner photographed at seated eye-level with a normal lens, showing a close three-quarter view from the foot of the bed looking toward the nightstand and wall. A warm, dappled glow emanates from the table surface, casting a lattice-like projected pattern of warm light across the rough plaster wall behind it — dots and diamonds of warm gold decorating the wall surface at table height. The light pools intimately on the bench surface and nearby floor without extending upward to the ceiling. The palette is entirely warm, natural, and textural — rough plaster, raw wood, washed linen, and woven jute — evoking a Scandinavian farmhouse calm.
